chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdullah, from his father, from Wahb, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), who said:

Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said: 'Men were created from the earth, and their preoccupation is in the earth. And the woman was created from the men, and her preoccupation is in the men. Restrain your women, O assembly of men!'

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Commander of the Faithful (Ali ibn Abi Talib)

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'restrain your women' in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith, found in Al-Kafi, establishes a metaphysical basis for gender roles by linking men to the earth (material/earthly focus) and women to men (relational focus), a concept often discussed in Shia exegetical traditions regarding complementary natures. The command to 'restrain' (ihbisu) women is interpreted not merely as confinement but as a protective guardianship (qiwamah) to safeguard their spiritual and social well-being within the domestic sphere. This narration underscores the husband's responsibility to actively fortify the marriage bond, aligning with the broader Shia emphasis on family stability as a cornerstone of societal order.
